title: Christmas comes alive in Quezon City with 50-foot tree, festive bazaar
summary: A towering 50-foot Christmas tree illuminated the Quezon City Hall grounds on Wednesday evening as Mayor Joy Belmonte led the city’s annual Christmas tree lighting ceremony.
